parameters.query:
SELECT $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object(
  'dadata', (SELECT data FROM dadata_cache WHERE inn = $2 AND fetched_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
  'dadata_cached', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dadata_cache WHERE inn = $2 AND fetched_at > now() - interval '30 days')) AS state

WITH rel AS (
  DELETE FROM client_locks WHERE inbox_id = $1
), u AS (
  UPDATE inbox SET status = 'new', attempt_count = greatest(attempt_count - 1, 0), locked_at = NULL,
                   next_attempt_at = now() + interval '20 seconds', updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO lead_events (inbox_id, step, detail, execution_id)
VALUES ($1, 'deferred', jsonb_build_object('reason', 'same client is being processed by another worker'), $2)
RETURNING id

SELECT $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object(
  'cfg', (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, value) FROM settings WHERE key <> 'alert_chat_id'),
  'execution_id', $2::text) AS state

WITH want AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb) AS k),
got AS (
  INSERT INTO client_locks (comm_key, inbox_id) SELECT k, $3 FROM want
  ON CONFLICT (comm_key) DO UPDATE SET inbox_id = EXCLUDED.inbox_id, locked_at = now()
   WHERE client_locks.inbox_id = EXCLUDED.inbox_id OR client_locks.locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
  RETURNING comm_key
)
SELECT $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('locked', (SELECT count(*) FROM got) = (SELECT count(*) FROM want)) AS state

WITH u AS (
  UPDATE inbox SET status = 'done', result = $2::jsonb, processed_at = now(), locked_at = NULL,
                   last_error = NULL, execution_id = $3, updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
), rel AS (
  DELETE FROM client_locks WHERE inbox_id = $1
), a AS (
  UPDATE assignments SET deal_id = $4, sla_item_id = $5,
         crm_created_at = coalesce(crm_created_at, now()), sla_due = coalesce(sla_due, $6::timestamptz)
   WHERE inbox_id = $1 RETURNING inbox_id
), e AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_events (inbox_id, deal_id, step, detail, execution_id)
  SELECT $1, $4, x.step, x.detail, $3 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($7::jsonb) AS x(step text, detail jsonb)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM u) AS inbox_updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM a) AS assignment_updated, (SELECT count(*) FROM e) AS events

WITH u AS (
  UPDATE inbox SET status = 'rejected', last_error = $2, processed_at = now(), locked_at = NULL,
                   execution_id = $3, updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO lead_events (inbox_id, step, detail, execution_id)
SELECT $1, x.step, x.detail, $3 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($4::jsonb) AS x(step text, detail jsonb)
RETURNING id

SELECT $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('route', to_jsonb(r)) AS state
  FROM route_lead($2::bigint, $3, $4, $5::int) r

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO dadata_cache (inn, found, data)
  SELECT $1, $2::boolean, $3::jsonb WHERE $4::boolean
  ON CONFLICT (inn) DO UPDATE SET found = EXCLUDED.found, data = EXCLUDED.data, fetched_at = now()
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT $5::jsonb AS state
